title: Publish and Subscribe
subtitle: Publish an event once and let any number of subscribers pick it up, as long as they can keep up
motto: Announce it once, and let whoever cares listen
coreAddition: broker with topics and consumer groups
keyInsight: A broker cuts the publisher's work to one send and decouples it from its subscribers, but it moves the problems to consumer lag, duplicate deliveries and the broker itself.

decisions.title: Start from a publisher that calls everyone
decisions.description: The first frame is the tightly coupled signup service from the vault, with its latency growing with the number of subscribers.
decisions.alternatives: Starting from a broker would not show what the pattern removes.

decisions.title: Fail with a slow subscriber, not a broken broker
decisions.description: The failure frame lets one subscriber fall behind, since lag on one consumer is the everyday failure and one the publisher never sees.
decisions.alternatives: Showing a broker outage would hide the more common, quieter problem.
